meaning:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Isa.1:1; עָמוֹס, Amo.1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mat.1:10.
2. Amos: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Amos

elsewhere.note: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
